sample_type.evidence_source: The British Cohort Study (BCS), originally developed as the British Birth Survey and as a sequel to the NCDS, included all babies (n = 17,196) born in Great Britain during the week of 05–11 April 1970.

ethnicity.evidence_source: Virtually all (96.7%) of the BCS respondents were Caucasian.
